title: How can architects use Claude and voice tools to automate administrative writing on Mac
metaTitle: Automate Administrative Writing: How Architects Use Claude and Lazur on Mac
description: Architects spend 40 percent of their time on admin. Learn how to use Claude and Lazur on your Mac to automate reports, emails, and documentation.
intro: Architects often find that administrative writing consumes more than 40 percent of their billable time. You can use Claude to draft project reports and email responses, and use Lazur to dictate these drafts directly into your Mac apps. By combining AI research with voice-driven input, you stop manual typing and focus on design.
tldr: Architects lose 40 percent of their time to non-billable administrative tasks.
Use Claude to structure project reports, RFI responses, and client emails.
Use Lazur to dictate those AI-generated drafts into Gmail, Word, or project management tools.
Centralize your communication to avoid fragmented email threads.
Focus on design while AI handles the repetitive documentation.

blocks.text: The hidden cost of administrative writing

Modern architectural practice functions like air traffic control. You manage engineers, contractors, and clients while keeping design intent clear. This requires constant communication. You likely handle 50 to 150 emails every single day. Most of these require technical review or specific code compliance language. When you type these manually, you lose hours of focus. A 50-person firm loses roughly 100 billable hours every week just from inefficient administrative processes. This is not just about speed. It is about the mental shift required to jump from a complex BIM model to a client email. Every time you switch tasks, you lose momentum.
Why administrative writing drains your design time

The primary cause of this drain is fragmented communication. Your project records are often trapped in long, unsearchable email threads. Decisions are made verbally on site and then confirmed in emails that never make it to your project management software. This creates a risk of rework. If you cannot find a specific change order or technical directive, you waste time digging through your inbox. Furthermore, many architecture firms operate on lump-sum fee models. Unlike hourly professional services, you absorb the cost of these administrative overruns. When you spend two hours a day on email, that is time you cannot bill to a client.
How can architects use Claude to draft documentation

You can use Claude as an intelligent drafting partner for your project documentation. Instead of writing an RFI response from scratch, paste your notes into Claude. Ask it to format your raw thoughts into professional, clear language. For example, tell Claude to draft a response to a contractor regarding a site condition. Provide the key facts, the relevant code section, and the desired outcome. Claude can generate a draft that maintains your firm's professional tone. You then review the draft and use Lazur to dictate final adjustments directly into your email client or project management platform.

If you handle sensitive client or patient data, always follow your firm's specific rules on data privacy and AI usage. Never upload confidential project files or proprietary design data to public AI tools without approval.

blocks.text: Fixes anyone can use on a Mac

items: Use TextExpander to create snippets for repetitive phrases in your technical specifications.
Use Obsidian to build a personal knowledge vault for project notes and common code references.
Create a centralized system of record for all project communication, rather than relying on email threads.
Draft responses in a dedicated AI interface like Claude, then copy and edit before sending.
Set aside specific blocks of time for email to prevent constant task switching.

blocks.text: Speed up your workflow with Lazur

Lazur helps you bridge the gap between AI drafting and your actual work on the Mac. Once Claude generates a draft, use Lazur to dictate that text into your cursor. Hold the fn key and speak naturally. Lazur formats your speech into clean, professional text. If you need to find a specific file or open a project folder, just hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask. Lazur points at the item on your screen or guides you through the steps to find it. This keeps your hands on your design tools and off the keyboard for routine admin tasks.
To reclaim your time, organize your day around focused design blocks and efficient admin bursts. Use this schedule to manage your workload.

rows: Ask Lazur to open your project folder and daily tasks.
Hold ⌥ ⌘ to check status or search without leaving your app.
Dictate emails and reports using Lazur's dictation.
Ask Lazur to set reminders for tomorrow's site visits.

faq.question: Can I use Claude to write project reports?
faq.answer: Yes. You can provide your raw field notes to Claude and ask it to structure them into a formal report. Always review the output for accuracy before sending.

faq.question: How does Lazur help with email?
faq.answer: Lazur allows you to dictate your responses directly into Gmail. It also helps you navigate your inbox and open attachments by voice.

faq.question: Is my data secure when using Lazur?
faq.answer: Lazur listens and looks at your screen only while you hold the activation key. The data is not stored or used to train AI models.
